---
title: "District Map"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    resources:
      - "files/other/ca_senate_districts.geojson"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Each district is colored by its senator's party. Hover for the senator and
how their fundraising is going; click to open their page.

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(htmlwidgets)
source("scripts/shared.R")

districts <- st_read("files/other/ca_senate_districts.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

# Party colors match $party-dem / $party-rep in styles/brand.scss
PARTY_FILL <- c(D = "#1560a8", R = "#c22e2e")
VACANT_FILL <- "#9aa3ad"

senators <- load_senators() |>
  mutate(display_name = paste(Last.Name, First.Name, sep = ", "))
fin <- senator_finance(senators) |> select(District, Raised, Goal, Pct)
# Only what the map shows — the roster's own Goal column would collide
# with fin's on the join
roster <- senators |> select(District, display_name, Party)

districts <- districts |>
  left_join(roster, by = c("district" = "District")) |>
  left_join(fin,    by = c("district" = "District")) |>
  mutate(
    fill = ifelse(is.na(Party), VACANT_FILL, unname(PARTY_FILL[Party])),
    # The hover card: name (party) · district, then the fundraising bar
    money_line = ifelse(
      is.na(Goal),
      '<span class="muted">No fundraising goal set</span>',
      progress_bar_html(Pct, sprintf("%s of %s &middot; %s%%",
                                      scales::dollar(Raised), scales::dollar(Goal), round(Pct)))
    ),
    tip = ifelse(
      is.na(Party),
      sprintf('<div class="map-tip"><b>District %s</b> &middot; vacant</div>', district),
      sprintf('<div class="map-tip"><b>%s</b> (%s) &middot; District %s<div class="map-tip-money">%s</div></div>',
              htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name), Party, district, money_line)
    )
  )

# Esri's gray canvas needs no API key (Carto's tiles now watermark
# keyless use) and suits the muted paper palette. Its matching
# REFERENCE layer adds city/place names for orientation — drawn in a
# high pane so the labels float above the district fills (tile layers
# don't catch clicks, so the districts stay clickable).
map <- leaflet(districts) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
  addMapPane("place-labels", zIndex = 650) |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attribution = "Labels © Esri",
    options = tileOptions(pane = "place-labels")
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "#17345a",
    fillColor = ~fill,
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    dashArray = "1",
    layerId = ~district,
    highlight = highlightOptions(
      weight = 4,
      color = "#d4a821",
      dashArray = "",
      fillOpacity = 0.65,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = lapply(districts$tip, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "6px 10px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = unname(PARTY_FILL), labels = c("Democrat", "Republican"),
    opacity = 0.6
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -120, lat = 36.5, zoom = 5)

# Clicking a district opens that senator's page. The click is bound to each
# polygon layer itself, so it lands on the exact district shape (not a
# bounding box), and the URL is relative so it works wherever the site lives.
#
# Arriving with ?district=N (the district link on a senator's page) zooms
# to that district and keeps it outlined in gold, with its label open.
map |>
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      var want = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('district');
      var picked = { weight: 4, color: '#d4a821', dashArray: '', fillOpacity: 0.65 };
      this.eachLayer(function(layer) {
        if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId) {
          layer.on('click', function() {
            window.open('senator-pages/district_' + layer.options.layerId + '.html', '_blank');
          });
          if (want && String(layer.options.layerId) === want) {
            map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), { padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 10 });
            layer.setStyle(picked);
            layer.bringToFront();
            layer.openTooltip(layer.getBounds().getCenter());
            // the hover highlight resets the style on mouseout; put it back
            layer.on('mouseout', function() {
              setTimeout(function() { layer.setStyle(picked); }, 0);
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }
  ")
```
